usedFor: Fireworks AI runs models, and “Transcribe audio” and “Translate audio” work on recordings.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message in Channels” in Slack, then “Translate audio” in Fireworks AI
bestTemplate.why: A new channel message can start an audio translation.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so “Transcribe audio” runs then, not instantly.
